Manifest.Name: 储藏区美化 | Storage Bay Appearance
Manifest.Author: Xxuebi
Manifest.Description: 将鼠标悬停在支持的容器上按 F7 打开外观窗口。可在齿轮设置中关闭快捷键或更改键位。支持储藏区、机器区、超科技储藏区、走私者暗格及其适配版本，启用酿酒拓展后还支持 xuxu 迷你储存区。支持游戏的 8 种界面语言。 / Hover over a supported container and press F7 to open Appearance. Use the gear settings to disable or rebind the shortcut. Supports storage bays, machine bays, Hypertech Bays, smuggler's bays and their supported variants, plus xuxu Mini Storage with Brewing Expansion. Available in all 8 game interface languages.
